name: Sally Del Testa
original_name: サリィ・デル・テスタ
source:
A genius hacker who loves Japan's Harajuku fashion.

Gaining illegal access to information through the internet, she has committed numerous cyber crimes. However, having no sense of the wrongness of her actions, she dislikes being called a cracker.

Because of an incident in her past, she avoids elevators.

Hometown: Chiusa [Italy]
